summary: Built the AXON motion research page as a full-viewport black canvas: a GPU particle cloud shaped by a twisted open ring SDF, stirred by a 256/512 GPU fluid sim and a slight gaze camera, with the monospace UI (brand, counter, ten chips, four looping videos, and the four text blocks). Shader attribute clashes that left the canvas black were fixed, and desktop plus a 390px layout were checked in the browser: the cloud forms, the cursor breaks and then heals it, and chips and cards hide below 760px.
current_status: The hub is a static page (index.html, styles.css, main.js). Particles, fluid cursor, and the specified UI are in place and visually verified.
